NISHA SUDHAKAR PATIL

Operations Analyst | Middle Office Solutions – Trade Operations

Pune, Maharashtra | +91 9702164555 | nishupatil31012000@gmail.com

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/nisha-patil-192a75325

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Operations Analyst with 2.5+ years of experience in Middle Office Trade Operations at Citco Group Services (India) LLP. Recognized as Employee of the Quarter for sustaining 100% SLA adherence across Fixed Income, Equities, and OTC Derivatives trade affirmations. Experienced in trade affirmation, settlement instruction management, exception investigation, broker/prime broker coordination, SSI maintenance, and process documentation.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Citco Group Services (India) LLP – Pune, Maharashtra

Operations Analyst – Middle Office Solutions (Trade Operations)

Feb 2024 – Present

Manage 50–70 manual trade affirmations per client daily across Fixed Income, Equities, and FX using CTM (DTCC) and Traiana with 100% SLA adherence.

Resolve 30–40 daily trade exceptions by investigating ISIN mismatches, trade economics, SSIs, and static data issues.

Coordinate with Executing Brokers, Prime Brokers, Fund Managers, and clients to resolve settlement discrepancies.

Maintain Standing Settlement Instructions (SSIs) across DTC, Fedwire, and Euroclear with working knowledge of SWIFT MT messaging.

Train junior team members on platform navigation, break handling, and client communication.

Create and maintain SOPs for exception handling and operational processes.

S.M. Bhoir & Co. – Navi Mumbai

Tax Associate

Jun 2022 – Jun 2023

Assisted with GST registration, GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B filing, statutory compliance, and Income Tax Return documentation for salaried individuals.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• Middle Office Trade Operations

• Trade Affirmation & Matching

• Trade Lifecycle Management (T+0/T+1)

Exception Investigation & Break Resolution

Fixed Income, Equities & FX

Settlement Instructions (DTC, Fedwire, Euroclear)

SWIFT MT Messaging

Position & Cash Reconciliation

SSI Management

SOP Creation & Process Documentation

Client Relationship Management

Hedge Fund & Institutional Client Servicing

CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS

Employee of the Quarter – Citco Group Services (India) LLP

Certification Program in Investment Banking Operations – Imarticus Learning (Aug 2023 – Dec 2023)

EDUCATION

MBA – MMS (Finance)

Mumbai University | 2022

Bachelor of Commerce – Accounting & Finance (B.Com-BAF)

Mumbai University | 2020

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES & LANGUAGES

Platforms: CTM (DTCC), Traiana, MTM Trade Affirmation, NYFIX, Tradeweb TRAX, Deal Manager, AxEo, Markit

MS Excel: VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Pivot Tables, Conditional Formatting, Data Validation

Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi
